systems.system: Education Management Information System (EMIS), with the school census forms
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Training (Director Planning, Chief Statistician, IT Manager), with UNICEF Lesotho support
systems.tiers: Paper-based with central data entry and highly centralised data management that prevents feedback to schools; 2020 and 2021 data not yet published

systems.platform: OpenEMIS (Core, with SMS, Logistics and Monitoring modules to be tested)
systems.owner: Ministry of Education and Training, with UNICEF Lesotho funding the consultancy
systems.tiers: Not rolled out: the Open EMIS Core toolkit was tested from August 2019; the consultancy is to test further, run a pilot of a paperless system, train central and district EMIS staff and write a costed implementation plan for 2023-2028

note: No fact: the terms of reference describe the EMIS in use as a paper-based school census keyed centrally, with 'limited capability' to track data by individual learner or teacher, so it is class census. Open EMIS is under test as a paperless replacement, and the document does not say that schools would enter learner records in it.
